how_to_add: Add an event or a year in this file only. No template change. One events object is one edition: slug (ep-shanghai-2026), series (ep-shanghai; every year of that show uses the same series and the same name), name (EP Shanghai), year, past_name (the single-year past label, EP Shanghai 2026), start (YYYY-MM-DD), end (YYYY-MM-DD), timezone (IANA), url (event page path), source_url (the page that states the dates), source_note. On the company, add one history entry per edition it attended: event (the edition slug), year, source (http or https URL of the exhibitor list for that year). slug, name, and aliases identify the company. source is required. CI rejects this file when any history entry is missing source, when source is blank, or when source is not an http(s) URL. Do not add a year that has no exhibitor list. On and before the end date, in that timezone, the year stays highlighted: Exhibiting at {name} · {dates}. Years of the same series that have already ended share one line, most recent first: Exhibited at EP Shanghai 2026 · 2025. A show with one past year reads Exhibited at WETEX 2025. The next calendar day after the end date, the highlighted year joins that line on its own. The browser recomputes both lines from the badge dates, so the move happens between builds. EP Shanghai 2026 is the only sourced year in this file. Its history source is the official exhibitor-list page https://www.epchinashow.com/EP/visitor/exhibitorlist/eng. The names were taken from the partial exhibitor-list PDF dated 2026-08-31. Do not invent 2025 or any other year.

events.source_note: Official visiting information lists the exhibition as 3–5 December 2026 at the Shanghai New International Expo Center. Opening hours are 09:00–16:30 on 3 and 4 December 2026 and 09:00–15:00 on 5 December 2026. The badge stays highlighted through the end date in Asia/Shanghai. Each company history entry cites the official exhibitor-list page. The names themselves come from the partial exhibitor-list PDF dated 2026-08-31. No earlier year is listed because this file has no exhibitor list for one.
